data.description: Al Satwa: Where Tradition Meets Urban Convenience in the Heart of Dubai.

data.answer:
Al Satwa is a well-established community in Dubai, known for its unique blend of old and new. The area is home to a mix of expatriates and locals, creating a diverse and multicultural environment. The community is characterized by its low-rise residential buildings, villas, and commercial spaces, making it a popular choice for those seeking affordable housing close to the city center.

The neighborhood is divided into several sub-communities, each offering its own distinct character and amenities. The residential areas are predominantly made up of apartments, with a few villas scattered throughout the neighborhood. The streets of Al Satwa are lined with shops, cafes, and restaurants, offering residents easy access to everyday conveniences. The community is also known for its proximity to major landmarks and attractions, including the iconic Burj Khalifa and the Dubai Mall, which are just a short drive away.

The lifestyle in Al Satwa is vibrant and dynamic, with a strong sense of community. The area is known for its bustling markets, where you can find everything from textiles to electronics. Al Satwa's streets come alive in the evenings, with families and friends gathering at local cafes and eateries. Despite its central location, Al Satwa has managed to retain its traditional charm, making it a unique neighborhood in Dubai.

Al Satwa is a vibrant neighborhood offering a diverse range of both residential and commercial properties. The residential options primarily include apartment buildings with units that vary from studios to spacious 3-bedroom apartments. These apartments are designed with modern amenities, featuring master bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms, built-in wardrobes, and expansive windows that allow plenty of natural light, and open-plan kitchens connected to comfortable living and dining areas. Additionally, some apartments come equipped with a separate maid’s room, complete with its own bathroom, catering to the needs of larger households.

Beyond apartments, Al Satwa also boasts a selection of villas, typically offering between 3 to 6 bedrooms. These villas are elegantly designed with high-quality finishes such as wooden and marble flooring, and they come with well-appointed master bedrooms, ample storage spaces, and large balconies. The spacious kitchens and dining areas are ideal for family living, while additional features like separate quarters for maids and drivers, temperature-controlled swimming pools, private gardens, and secure parking spaces add a touch of luxury and convenience to the living experience.

For those seeking more luxurious accommodations, Al Satwa offers 3 to 4-bedroom penthouses that range in size from 2,750 to 4,000 square feet. These penthouses provide expansive living spaces, often with panoramic views of the surrounding cityscape.

On the commercial side, Al Satwa is home to a variety of office spaces and retail shops. The office spaces available in the area cater to businesses of all sizes, with options ranging from compact units of around 100 square feet to larger spaces that cover nearly 6,000 square feet. Retail shops in Al Satwa also vary in size, with units available from 215 to 5,200 square feet, making the area a bustling hub for business activity alongside its residential offerings.

Popular Buildings in Al Satwa

Al Satwa is home to several notable buildings that cater to a diverse range of residents and businesses. Here are some of the most popular buildings in the area:
Al Hudaiba Awards Building: Known for its iconic design, Al Hudaiba Awards Building is a mixed-use development that houses government offices as well as residential apartments. The building is centrally located, offering easy access to major roads and public transportation.
Al Badaa Building: Located at the edge of Al Satwa, Al Badaa Building offers affordable apartments with essential amenities. Its strategic location makes it a convenient choice for residents who want to be close to both Al Satwa and Jumeirah.
Satwa Roundabout Building: This well-known building is a hub for commercial and residential spaces, offering both offices and apartments. Its location near the iconic Satwa roundabout makes it a prominent landmark in the area, with easy access to shopping centers and dining spots.
Al Ghazal Building: A popular residential choice, Al Ghazal Building provides a mix of one- and two-bedroom apartments. Its close proximity to local supermarkets, schools, and healthcare facilities makes it ideal for families looking to settle in Al Satwa.

Properties for Rent in Al Satwa

Renting a property in Al Satwa is a popular choice for those looking for affordable housing in a central location. The rental market in Al Satwa is diverse, with options to suit different needs and budgets. Looking for a property in Dubai at a reasonable price? One-bedroom apartments in Al Satwa typically start at around AED 45,000 per year, while two-bedroom apartments can range from AED 65,000 to AED 80,000 per year. For those seeking larger spaces, three-bedroom apartments are available starting at AED 85,000 per year.

Properties for Sale in Al Satwa

For those interested in buying property, Al Satwa offers a range of property for sale in Dubai at competitive prices. One-bedroom apartments for sale in Al Satwa typically start at around AED 600,000, while two-bedroom units can range from AED 800,000 to AED 1.2 million. Villas in Al Satwa are less common but can be found, with prices starting at AED 2.5 million for a three-bedroom villa.

Al Satwa Off Plan Properties

Alba Tower is a contemporary 12-story residential complex developed by the renowned Reportage Properties. The project comprises 72 luxury units, including 40 one-bedroom apartments and 32 two-bedroom apartments. Each residence features a modern interior design, double-glazed windows, central air conditioning, fiber optic internet connectivity, and balconies that offer stunning panoramic views.

more_info.question: What to Expect When Living in Dubai Al Satwa?

data.answer:
Living in Al Satwa offers a unique experience, combining the convenience of urban living with the charm of a traditional neighborhood. The area is known for its lively atmosphere, with streets bustling with activity throughout the day. Residents enjoy easy access to a wide range of amenities, including shops, restaurants, and public transportation.

The community in Al Satwa is close-knit, with a strong sense of camaraderie among residents. The neighborhood is home to a diverse population, including families, professionals, and expatriates from various backgrounds. The area is particularly popular among young professionals and families, who are drawn to its affordability and central location.

Despite its bustling nature, Al Satwa also offers pockets of tranquility, with quiet residential streets and parks where residents can relax and unwind. The neighborhood is well-connected to other parts of Dubai, making it easy to explore the city and take advantage of all that it has to offer.

Parking and Public Transport in Al Satwa, Dubai

Al Satwa is well served by public transportation, making it easy to get around the city. The Al Satwa Bus Station is a major hub in the area, providing access to various bus routes that connect to different parts of Dubai. The Al Satwa Bus Station Dubai is conveniently located on Al Satwa Road, just a short walk from most residential areas.

For those who prefer to travel by metro, the nearest metro station is the World Trade Center Metro Station, located just a 5-minute drive from Al Satwa. The station is part of the Red Line, providing easy access to key destinations such as Dubai International Airport, Dubai Marina, and Jebel Ali. Al Satwa Dubai Metro connectivity makes it convenient for residents to commute to work or explore the city.

Supermarkets in Al Satwa

Al Satwa is home to several supermarkets, providing residents with easy access to everyday essentials. Popular options include Choithrams, located on Al Satwa Road, just a 3-minute drive from the residential areas. Other supermarkets in the vicinity include Carrefour Market, which is a 5-minute drive away, and Lulu Hypermarket, located just 7 minutes from Al Satwa. 

Additionally, residents can shop at Big Value Supermarket, Safe Wall Grocery, Shams Al Madina Grocery, OKD Supermarket, Raawi Al Madina, Al Mezhar Grocery, Eijad Mini Mart, New W Mart, Al Saqa Plaza Supermarket, and Ghosn Al Madina Grocery, all conveniently located within the neighborhood.

Shopping Malls in Al Satwa

While Al Satwa does not have its own large shopping mall, residents can easily access several popular malls in nearby areas. The Dubai Mall, one of the largest shopping centers in the world and just a 10-minute drive from Al Satwa, is home to a variety of luxury brands, making it a prime shopping destination for fashion lovers.

Additionally, City Walk, located just 7 minutes away, offers a more relaxed shopping experience with high-end stores, perfect for those looking for a blend of luxury and boutique shopping. For a more quaint and charming atmosphere, Mercato Shopping Mall, located 10 minutes from Al Satwa, cater to shoppers with a taste for individuality and style.

Schools in and Near Al Satwa

Al Satwa is well-served by a number of schools, making it a convenient location for families with children. Nearby schools include Jumeirah English Speaking School (JESS), located just a 10-minute drive away, and GEMS Wellington Primary School, which is also a 10-minute drive from Al Satwa. For older students, the Dubai International School is just 8 minutes away, offering a curriculum that caters to a diverse student body.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Al Satwa

Al Satwa is a multicultural neighborhood, and residents have access to a variety of religious places. The neighborhood is home to several mosques, including the Satwa Grand Mosque, located on Al Satwa Road. For those of other faiths, St. Mary’s Catholic Church is a 10-minute drive away, while the Hindu Temple in Bur Dubai is just 15 minutes from Al Satwa.

Clinics and Hospitals in and Near Al Satwa

Residents of Al Satwa have access to a range of healthcare facilities, including clinics and hospitals. The Mediclinic Al Satwa is a popular choice, located just a 5-minute drive from the heart of the neighborhood. Other nearby healthcare options include Aster Clinic, which is a 7-minute drive away, and the Iranian Hospital Dubai, located just 10 minutes from Al Satwa.

Al Satwa Location & Nearby Areas

Al Satwa is strategically located in the heart of Dubai, making it an ideal place for those who want to be close to the city’s major attractions and business districts. The neighborhood is bordered by Sheikh Zayed Road to the south and Jumeirah to the west, providing easy access to both residential and commercial areas.

Nearby areas include Al Wasl and Bur Dubai, both of which offer a range of amenities and attractions. Al Wasl is just a 5-minute drive away, known for its vibrant community and upscale lifestyle, with close proximity to parks, cafes, and boutique shops. Bur Dubai, a historic district located about 10 minutes from Al Satwa, offers a rich cultural experience with its traditional souks, museums, and heritage sites.

Additionally, other nearby areas include Downtown Dubai, just a 10-minute drive away, and Jumeirah, located only 5 minutes from Al Satwa. The area’s central location also makes it easy to reach other parts of Dubai, including Dubai Marina, which is a 20-minute drive away, and Dubai International Airport, located just 15 minutes from Al Satwa.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Al Satwa

data.answer:
Al Satwa offers a wide range of activities and attractions, catering to residents and visitors alike. Whether you’re interested in dining, shopping, or exploring the outdoors, there’s something for everyone in this vibrant neighborhood.

Restaurants In and Near Al Satwa

Al Satwa is a culinary hotspot, offering a wide range of dining options. Ravi Restaurant, just a 3-minute drive from most residential areas, is famous for its authentic and affordable Pakistani dishes. Al Mallah, known for its signature shawarma and falafel, is a favorite for Middle Eastern cuisine, just 5 minutes away. Seafood lovers can head to Bu Qtair, a casual spot near Jumeirah, 10 minutes from Al Satwa.

The area also hosts other popular eateries like Eat & Drink Restaurant, Fillet King Restaurant, and Satwa Star Plus Restaurant, ensuring a variety of flavors and dining experiences for all tastes.

Beaches Near Al Satwa

Residents of Al Satwa can easily access some of Dubai’s most popular beaches. Jumeirah Public Beach (formerly known as Russian Beach) is just a 12-minute drive from Al Satwa, offering a picturesque spot for picnics, cycling, or a leisurely walk along the 1.8-kilometer running track.

Kite Beach, another favorite destination for water sports enthusiasts, is located just 15 minutes away, providing a lively atmosphere and a variety of activities. Additionally, Jumeirah Beach is only a 10-minute drive from Al Satwa, offering a beautiful stretch of sand and clear waters for relaxation and recreation.

Hotels in Al Satwa

While Al Satwa is primarily a residential area, there are several hotels nearby that cater to both tourists and business travelers. The Fairmont Dubai, located on Sheikh Zayed Road, is just a 5-minute drive from Al Satwa and offers luxurious accommodations with stunning views of the city. Another option is the Rove Trade Center, which is a 7-minute drive away and offers affordable yet stylish accommodations.

Attractions and Landmarks in and Near Al Satwa

Al Satwa’s central location makes it easy to access some of Dubai’s most famous attractions. The Burj Khalifa, the world’s tallest building, is just a 10-minute drive from Al Satwa, offering breathtaking views of the city. The Dubai Mall, also 10 minutes away, is a shopping and entertainment destination that offers everything from luxury boutiques to an indoor aquarium.

For those interested in art and culture, the Dubai Opera is located just 12 minutes from Al Satwa, offering a wide range of performances, from opera to ballet. The Etihad Museum, which is just a 7-minute drive away, provides a fascinating look at the history of the United Arab Emirates.

In addition to these iconic landmarks, residents can easily visit the Coca-Cola Arena, a state-of-the-art multi-purpose arena just 10 minutes away, hosting concerts, sports events, and entertainment shows. For nature enthusiasts, The Green Planet is a unique indoor tropical rainforest located 8 minutes from Al Satwa, offering an immersive experience with exotic plants and wildlife. The Museum of the Future, just 10 minutes away, is another must-visit attraction, showcasing cutting-edge technology and innovative exhibits that explore the possibilities of the future.

Outdoor Activities, Gyms, and Salons

Al Satwa offers several options for outdoor activities, including parks and fitness facilities. The nearby Safa Park, located just 10 minutes away, is a popular destination for jogging, picnicking, and enjoying the outdoors. For those looking for a gym in Al Satwa, Fitness First is a popular option, located just a 5-minute drive away.

There are also several salons in the area, offering a range of beauty and grooming services. NStyle Beauty Lounge, located just 7 minutes from Al Satwa, is a popular choice for residents looking for high-quality salon services.

While Al Satwa offers many benefits, one minor drawback is the traffic congestion during peak hours, particularly on Al Satwa Road. However, this can be mitigated by using public transportation, such as the nearby metro stations and bus services, which provide convenient alternatives to driving.

Is Satwa a good place to live in Dubai?

Yes, Satwa is a good place to live in Dubai, especially for those who value a central location, affordability, and a vibrant community. It offers a mix of residential options, including apartments and villas, and is well-connected to major parts of the city. The area is known for its multicultural atmosphere, bustling streets, and proximity to essential amenities, making it a convenient and lively place to call home.

How much is a taxi from Al Satwa to Burjuman?

The taxi fare from Al Satwa to Burjuman typically ranges between AED 20 and AED 30, depending on traffic and the time of day. The journey usually takes around 10 to 15 minutes by car.

Which metro station is the closest to Satwa?

The closest metro station to Satwa is the Financial Center Metro Station on the Red Line, which is about a 7-minute drive from the heart of the Satwa neighborhood.

What buses go to Satwa bus station?

Several buses service the Satwa bus station, including the popular X13 route. Other bus routes that stop at Satwa bus station include buses 15, 32C, and 93, providing convenient public transport options for residents and visitors.

What district is Satwa in Dubai?

Al Satwa is located in the heart of Dubai, within the Bur Dubai district. It is strategically positioned near Sheikh Zayed Road, bordered by the neighborhoods of Jumeirah, Al Wasl, and the Dubai World Trade Center area.

What is Al Satwa famous for?

Al Satwa is famous for its vibrant community, multicultural atmosphere, and bustling streets lined with shops, markets, and eateries. It is also known for its traditional charm, offering a glimpse into old Dubai while being well connected to modern conveniences and major attractions. Additionally, Al Satwa is recognized for its accessibility and proximity to key areas in Dubai, making it a popular choice for both residents and visitors.

data.content:
Al Satwa is a vibrant and bustling neighborhood in Dubai, known for its unique blend of tradition and modernity. Al Satwa is a small mixed-use district in Dubai, bordered by Al Wasl, Al Badaa, and the Dubai World Trade Centre. It’s close to Sheikh Zayed Road and offers a variety of apartments, penthouses, a few villas, and residential plots. The neighborhood is also home to Satwa Park and features commercial properties, including retail shops and offices for rent, making it a vibrant and well-connected area in the heart of the city.

Al Satwa offers easy access to various parts of the city, making it an ideal location for those who value convenience and connectivity. The neighborhood provides a wide range of property options, whether you’re looking to rent or buy, catering to different needs and budgets.

With its strategic location, vibrant community, and rich cultural heritage, Al Satwa truly embodies the spirit of Dubai. The area’s unique charm and accessibility make it a sought-after destination for those looking to experience the best of urban living in Dubai.
